svg.title: Five methods' stationary and stable coverage against an incomplete four-mode reference.
svg.desc: English: Five methods' stationary and stable coverage against an incomplete four-mode reference. 繁體中文：五種方法對尚未證明完整的四模態參照之平衡態及穩定態覆蓋。

cc:Work.dc:description: Matched method coverage in the predeclared ZIP M=4 zero-phase baseline, using the frozen original 128-start bank and common ordinary-root anchors and switching seeds. Panel (a) scores stationary outputs against the incomplete empirical reference; panel (b) scores Hessian-verified minima. Panel (c) explicitly subtracts PAL coverage from PAL+deflation for both outcomes, and from natural for stationary coverage, at the same saved slices: zero is coincident coverage, not a hidden gain. The lowest natural stationary coverage is marked explicitly; its narrow deficit is not erased by marker subsampling. Across all sixteen original settings, natural stationary loss occurs in 1 case(s), listed as ['zip-M4-phase0']; the saved records contain 0 nonunit defined stable-coverage entries among the five methods. All original settings' metrics are retained in the inputs, so the illustrated exception is not promoted to a universal result. 'Minima' denotes retained strict-minimum outputs, not every stationary optimizer output. PAL+deflation includes PAL and explicitly costed extra rediscovery. High slice coverage does not certify connected-branch tracking, complete higher-dimensional enumeration, equal budgets, or physical validity.
